rows.note: Use 打造 as the all-purpose choice for constructing or developing something substantial or skillfully made.

example.english: We craft a sturdy desk out of wood.
example.traditional: 我哋用木打造一張結實嘅書枱。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jung6 muk6 daa2 zou6 jat1 zoeng1 git3 sat6 ge3 syu1 toi2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for skill or technique, including skill in a particular art or trade.

example.english: Painting this picture takes a fair bit of craft.
example.traditional: 畫呢幅畫要有一定技巧。
example.jyutping: waak6 ni1 fuk1 waa2 jiu3 jau5 jat1 ding6 gei6 haau2

rows.note: Use 親手整 when stressing that something was made by hand rather than merely produced.

example.english: I craft this leather wallet by hand.
example.traditional: 呢個皮革銀包係我親手整㗎。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 pei4 gaak3 ngan4 baau1 hai6 ngo5 can1 sau2 zing2 gaa3

rows.note: Use this for a watercraft rather than for a flying craft.

example.english: We’re taking a craft to Cheung Chau.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zo6 syun4 heoi3 coeng4 zau1

rows.note: Use this for an aircraft or other flying craft; a space vehicle is usually named more specifically.

example.english: This craft can fly to Mars.
example.traditional: 呢架飛行器可以飛去火星。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaa3 fei1 haang4 hei3 ho2 ji5 fei1 heoi3 fo2 sing1

rows.note: Use 合成 when combining separate items into a new item, especially in games or crafting systems.

example.english: In the game, I craft a suit of armour by combining three gems.
example.traditional: 打機嗰陣，我用三粒寶石合成一件盔甲。
example.jyutping: daa2 gei1 go2 zan6 ngo5 jung6 saam1 lap1 bou2 sek6 hap6 sing4 jat1 gin6 kwai1 gaap3

rows.note: Use this for a skilled trade, occupation, or line of business, as in a carpenter's trade.

example.english: Carpentry is a craft that relies on manual skill.
example.traditional: 木工係一門要靠手藝嘅行業。
example.jyutping: muk6 gung1 hai6 jat1 mun4 jiu3 kaau3 sau2 ngai6 ge3 hong4 jip6
